• Cardiac Arrest Management

• Management of Coma

• Blood and Fluid Therapy in Trauma
• Structured Approach to Emergency Paediatrics
• Newborn Life Support - Australian / New Zealand Resuscitation Council 

These algorithms form part of the three day APLS course, regarded as the international gold standard in paediatric emergency training. They are intended for use by trained medical professionals who have completed a full APLS course in Australia or New Zealand only.
